test.name: A broad verify request audits the sources and checks the warnings, removes nothing, and offers each finding as a new project
test.description: Issue #4791 (lead, 2026-11-24): a verify request that names no particular relationship, fact or source does not clear the tree, and is its project's whole work. The router runs the attached-records baseline, source-evaluation, then check-warnings in the same turn, relays both, and gives each finding as its own next project, started from the same person ID with the narrow request. No tree_forget, no question, and no "Continue with …?" line. Both agents are stubbed with known findings.

Grade the reply on relaying both findings (the 1900 census birth year that does not fit, and the 1910 residence after his death) and giving each as its own next project: start a new project from Christian P. Hole's FamilySearch person ID (KD96-TV2) and answer its setup step with the narrow request, such as "Verify his birth date.". A reply that offers to verify a finding in this project, or asks which to verify first here, fails that.
The attached-records baseline (extraction_append with personId) may run before the audit; it is not a failure.
